newsitem.title: USA: Deswell expands facility in south China.
newsitem.headline: Deswell expands facility in south China.

text.p: Deswell Industries Inc said on Monday it leased an additional 40,000 square feet of factory space in Shenzhen, China, to meet growing demand for the company's injection molded plastic products.
The newly leased space in south China is adjacent to the company's existing premises, Deswell said.
The company also said it recently bought 30 more injection molding machines, to install at both its existing facilities and at the newly leased space over the coming months.
Richard Lau, chief executive, said, "The company's expansion plan is proceeding on schedule."
He said Deswell's Jetcrown plastics operations had expanded its production facilities by over 95,000 square feet over the past 18 months, bringing total production space to 225,000 square feet.
"With the additional lease of 40,000 square feet of new production space, Jetcrown will be able to meet the growing demand for its products and services throughout 1997," he said.
